notes: Knox's and Jeff's lunches are set up exactly as Jeff described (2026-11-14). Product picks: Knox's 'Boar's Head Italian blend with salami and cheese' = Boar's Head Uncured Genoa Salame & Picante Provolone 4 oz snack tray (the Boar's Head salami-plus-cheese product Jewel carries); his Cool Ranch Doritos come from the Sam's Doritos Mix 30-pack (most Cool Ranch of the Sam's variety packs; a party bag portioned into snack bags is the cheaper Cool Ranch-every-day option). Jeff's salad = Member's Mark Cobb Salad with Grilled Chicken & Avocado Ranch (Sam's deli; ranch-type dressing only; ~40 g protein a 10 oz portion). Quantities are per lunch in catalog units. 'healthy' is used honestly — Knox's chips, cookies and Yoo-hoo are not tagged healthy. nutritionHints give per-catalog-unit calories/protein from labels where found (source noted) for data/nutrition.json. 2026-11-15 (v2.5): Jeff alternates Jewel salad bowls (all with ranch) and a Boar’s Head spicy chicken sandwich he makes himself; Ritz portions from the pantry for Knox. 2026-11-15 (v2.5.3): no hot-deli sandwiches (Jeff: poor quality); Jeff’s salads are prepackaged store salads, ranch preferred, NEVER Caesar. 2026-11-15 (v2.5.4): Knox likes Cool Ranch Doritos only, never Nacho Cheese, so his chips come from a Cool Ranch party bag, not the variety pack. 2026-11-15 (v3): the two BLT salad bowls are out of the library (they come with raw grape tomatoes, and the house rule is no raw tomatoes); the Cobb salad says to pick the tomato pieces out. The validator now checks lunches against every house rule and for calories and protein. 2026-11-15 night (docs/spec/24): the Bonduelle Chicken BLT bowl is back for Jeff only ("people": ["Jeff"]), with the instruction to leave the tomatoes out; it is the one named exception in the validator (TOMATO_LEFT_OUT), and the Taylor Farms BLT bowl stays out. The family’s ranch is Wish-Bone.

items.title: Boar's Head Black Forest ham sandwich
items.subtitle: Smoky deli ham piled on whole-grain bread — Knox's go-to.
items.prep: Layer about 3 oz of ham on two slices of bread, cut in half and wrap tightly.
items.photo: A ham sandwich on whole-grain bread cut in half, thin folds of smoked ham visible, on a lunch napkin.

items.title: Boar's Head Italian salami & provolone
items.subtitle: Genoa salame and sharp provolone slices, ready to snack or stack.
items.prep: Pack the 4 oz tray as is and keep it cold with an ice pack.
items.photo: Rounds of Genoa salami fanned beside slices of provolone cheese in a small snack tray.

items.title: Chicken Cobb salad with avocado ranch
items.subtitle: Grilled chicken, egg, bacon and greens with creamy avocado ranch — about 40 g protein.
items.prep: Spoon about 10 oz (a third of the Sam's deli tray) into a lidded bowl; keep the dressing cup separate and use the tray within 3–4 days. Pick out any tomato pieces; only Candi eats them.
items.photo: A chopped Cobb salad in a clear bowl: romaine, grilled chicken strips, egg, bacon bits, with a cup of pale green ranch on the side.

items.title: Ranch chicken salad bowl
items.subtitle: Single-serve romaine bowl with chicken, cheddar, bacon bits and homestyle ranch.
items.prep: Grab one sealed bowl from the fridge — fork and dressing are inside.
items.photo: A single-serve salad bowl with romaine, chicken pieces, shredded carrot, cheddar and a ranch cup.

items.title: Ranch chicken salad bowl + extra grilled chicken
items.subtitle: The ranch bowl with 3 oz more grilled chicken so it actually keeps you full.
items.prep: Slice 3 oz of grilled chicken onto the bowl before you go.
items.photo: A single-serve romaine salad bowl topped with extra sliced grilled chicken breast and a ranch cup.

items.title: Grilled chicken garden salad, light ranch
items.subtitle: A big bowl of greens with 4 oz grilled chicken and light ranch — the lightest high-protein lunch.
items.prep: Fill a bowl with 4 oz salad mix, top with 4 oz sliced grilled chicken, and pack 2 tbsp light ranch in a small cup.
items.photo: A large bowl of mixed greens with shredded carrot and cabbage, topped with sliced grilled chicken, a small cup of white dressing.

items.title: Turkey & cheese wrap
items.subtitle: Sliced turkey, cheese and crisp romaine rolled in a soft tortilla.
items.prep: Layer turkey, cheese and a few romaine leaves on a tortilla, roll tightly and cut in half.
items.photo: A rolled turkey and cheese tortilla wrap cut on the diagonal showing turkey, cheese and green lettuce.

items.title: Ham & cheese spinach wrap
items.subtitle: Black Forest ham and cheese with baby spinach in a tortilla.
items.prep: Layer ham, cheese and a handful of spinach on a tortilla, roll tightly and cut in half.
items.photo: A ham and cheese wrap with baby spinach, cut in half to show the layers.

items.title: Greek-yogurt chicken salad with whole-grain crackers
items.subtitle: Creamy chicken salad made with Greek yogurt instead of mayo, scooped onto crackers.
items.prep: Mix half a drained can of chicken with 2 oz plain Greek yogurt, salt and pepper; pack with 1.5 oz crackers on the side.
items.photo: A small container of creamy chicken salad beside a stack of woven whole-grain crackers.

items.title: Peanut butter & banana sandwich
items.subtitle: Creamy peanut butter and sliced banana on whole-grain bread.
items.prep: Spread 2 tbsp peanut butter, add one sliced banana, close and cut in half.
items.photo: A peanut butter and banana sandwich on whole-grain bread, cut in half showing banana slices.

items.title: Doritos snack bag from the variety pack (mixed flavors)
items.subtitle: The Sam’s variety pack mixes Cool Ranch with Nacho Cheese and others. Knox gets the Cool Ranch portion instead.
items.prep: Grab one bag; Cool Ranch first while they last.
items.photo: A small single-serve bag of ranch-dusted tortilla chips spilling a few triangle chips.

items.title: Cool Ranch Doritos, portioned from a party bag
items.subtitle: Cool Ranch only (Knox doesn’t like Nacho Cheese), portioned from a party bag for about $0.37 a lunch.
items.prep: Scoop about 1.5 oz (a big handful) into a resealable snack bag.
items.photo: A handful of ranch-seasoned triangle tortilla chips in a clear zip snack bag.
items.batch: Bag the Doritos into {n} snack bags, about 1½ oz each,

items.title: Baked chips snack bag
items.subtitle: Baked Lay's, Cheetos or Ruffles — the crunch with less fat.
items.prep: Grab one bag from the baked variety pack.
items.photo: A single-serve bag of baked potato crisps with a few crisps beside it.

items.title: Baby carrots with a ranch cup
items.subtitle: Sweet crunchy carrots and a cup of ranch for dipping.
items.prep: Pack about 3 oz baby carrots with one ranch to-go cup.
items.photo: Baby carrots in a small container next to a little cup of white ranch dip.

items.title: Baby carrots with light ranch
items.subtitle: Same carrot-and-ranch crunch with light ranch.
items.prep: Pack about 3 oz baby carrots and 2 tbsp light ranch in a small lidded cup.
items.photo: Baby carrots beside a small lidded cup of white dressing.

items.title: Baby carrots & hummus
items.subtitle: Carrots with a single-serve cup of classic hummus.
items.prep: Pack about 3 oz baby carrots with one hummus cup.
items.photo: Baby carrots next to a small round cup of smooth hummus.

items.title: Apple
items.subtitle: A crisp whole apple (or slices).
items.prep: Pack one whole apple, or slice it and add a squeeze of lemon so it stays white.
items.photo: A red apple and a few fresh apple slices on a napkin.

items.title: Two clementines
items.subtitle: Easy-peel, sweet and school-friendly.
items.prep: Pack two clementines.
items.photo: Two bright orange clementines, one partly peeled.

items.title: Fruit cup (no sugar added)
items.subtitle: Peaches, mandarins or mixed fruit packed in water.
items.prep: Pack one cup and a spoon.
items.photo: A small clear cup of diced peaches in water with a spoon.

items.title: Cookie & cracker snack pack (Oreo Mini and friends)
items.subtitle: One 1 oz pack from the Nabisco 40-pack: Oreo Mini, Chips Ahoy!, Ritz Bits and more.
items.prep: Grab one pack — Oreos first if that's the favorite.
items.photo: A small snack bag of mini chocolate sandwich cookies with a few cookies spilled out.

items.title: Greek yogurt cup
items.subtitle: High-protein Greek yogurt in a single cup.
items.prep: Pack one cup with a spoon and an ice pack.
items.photo: A single cup of Greek yogurt with fruit at the bottom and a spoon.

items.title: String cheese
items.subtitle: One mozzarella stick — protein in a peel-able package.
items.prep: Pack one stick with an ice pack.
items.photo: A mozzarella string cheese stick partly peeled into strands.

items.title: Two hard-boiled eggs
items.subtitle: Peeled and ready — 12 g protein.
items.prep: Pack two peeled eggs in a small container with a pinch of salt and pepper.
items.photo: Two peeled hard-boiled eggs, one halved showing the yolk, with a sprinkle of pepper.

items.title: Protein bar
items.subtitle: Chewy peanut butter–chocolate protein bar.
items.prep: Toss one bar in the bag.
items.photo: A chewy peanut butter and chocolate protein bar, unwrapped, cut in half.

items.title: Cheese & whole-grain crackers
items.subtitle: A string cheese with an ounce of whole-grain crackers.
items.prep: Pack one string cheese with about 6 crackers.
items.photo: A string cheese stick beside a small stack of woven whole-grain crackers.

items.title: Apple & peanut butter
items.subtitle: Apple slices with a tablespoon of peanut butter for dipping.
items.prep: Slice one apple and pack 1 tbsp peanut butter in a small cup.
items.photo: Apple slices fanned around a small cup of creamy peanut butter.

items.title: Popcorn snack bag
items.subtitle: A light, salty 0.65 oz bag of ready-to-eat popcorn.
items.prep: Grab one bag.
items.photo: A small bag of white popcorn with a few fluffy kernels spilled out.

items.title: Yoo-hoo chocolate drink
items.subtitle: A 6.5 oz box of chocolate drink.
items.prep: Pack one box (chill overnight if you like it cold).
items.photo: A small chocolate drink box with a straw, beside a lunch bag.

items.title: Capri Sun Fruit Punch
items.subtitle: A 6 oz fruit punch pouch.
items.prep: Pack one Fruit Punch pouch (the Sam's pack also has other flavors).
items.photo: A silver juice pouch with a straw and a few drops of red fruit punch.

items.title: BODYARMOR Orange Mango
items.subtitle: A 16 oz Orange Mango sports drink — Jeff's daily pick.
items.prep: Chill one bottle overnight.
items.photo: A chilled 16 oz bottle of orange sports drink with condensation, plain label.

items.title: BODYARMOR LYTE (Orange Clementine)
items.subtitle: The low-calorie version — 20 calories. No Orange Mango LYTE exists, so this is the closest orange flavor.
items.prep: Chill one bottle overnight.
items.photo: A chilled 16 oz bottle of light orange sports drink with condensation, plain label.

items.title: Bottle of water
items.subtitle: 16.9 oz purified water.
items.prep: Pack one bottle (freeze it the night before to double as an ice pack).
items.photo: A clear bottle of water with condensation on a counter.

items.title: Sparkling water
items.subtitle: Unsweetened sparkling water — lime, lemon or grapefruit.
items.prep: Pack one cold can.
items.photo: A cold can of sparkling water beside a glass with ice and a lime wedge.

items.title: Milk box
items.subtitle: Shelf-stable 8 oz organic milk — 8 g protein.
items.prep: Pack one box; it doesn't need the fridge until opened.
items.photo: A small white milk carton box with a straw.

items.title: Bonduelle Chef salad bowl (turkey & ham)
items.subtitle: Turkey and ham with creamy ranch. 250 cal, 12 g protein.
items.prep: Grab one from the fridge: the fork and ranch are inside. For a lighter lunch, use half the dressing.
items.photo: A clear single-serve chef salad bowl with lettuce, folded turkey and ham, shredded cheddar and a ranch cup.

items.title: Bonduelle Kickin' BBQ chicken salad bowl
items.subtitle: BBQ-style chicken with BBQ ranch. 230 cal, 9 g protein.
items.prep: Grab one from the fridge: the fork and BBQ ranch are inside.
items.photo: A clear single-serve salad bowl with lettuce, BBQ chicken, corn and black beans, with a BBQ ranch cup.

items.title: Bonduelle Chicken BLT salad bowl, hold the tomatoes
items.subtitle: Chicken, bacon and greens with buttermilk ranch; the tomatoes come off. 260 cal, 11 g protein.
items.prep: Grab one from the fridge and leave the tomatoes out: pick them off the top before the ranch goes on. The fork and ranch are inside. For a lighter lunch, use half the dressing.
items.photo: A clear single-serve salad bowl with chopped iceberg and romaine lettuce, grilled chicken strips, bacon pieces and shredded cheese, a ranch cup beside it.

items.title: Ritz crackers from the pantry box
items.subtitle: About 9 crackers in a snack bag, from the boxes already at home.
items.prep: Count about 9 Ritz into a snack bag.
items.batch: Bag the Ritz into {n} snack bags, about 9 each,
items.photo: About nine round buttery crackers in a small clear zip snack bag.

items.title: Boar's Head spicy chicken sandwich with pickles, hot giardiniera and chips
items.subtitle: Blazing Buffalo chicken on Artesano with dill chips and Buona hot giardiniera, Miss Vickie’s on the side. About 600 cal and 35 g protein.
items.prep: Layer about 4 oz of the chicken on two slices of bread with dill pickle chips and a spoonful of hot giardiniera. Bag a handful (1½ oz) of Miss Vickie’s on the side.
items.photo: A deli sandwich on soft white bakery bread stacked with sliced buffalo chicken breast, dill pickle chips and spicy Chicago giardiniera, with kettle chips beside it.

items.title: Bonduelle Chicken Queso Fresco salad bowl
items.subtitle: Chicken and queso fresco over greens, dressing inside. A no-prep store salad.
items.prep: Grab one from the fridge: the fork and dressing are inside. For a lighter lunch, use half the dressing.
items.photo: A clear single-serve salad bowl with greens, grilled chicken, crumbled queso fresco and a dressing cup on top.

items.title: Bonduelle Santa Fe salad bowl
items.subtitle: Southwest-style salad with chicken, dressing inside. A no-prep store salad.
items.prep: Grab one from the fridge: the fork and dressing are inside.
items.photo: A clear single-serve salad bowl with greens, chicken, black beans, corn and tortilla strips, a dressing cup on top.

items.title: Boar's Head Salsalito turkey sandwich with pickles, hot giardiniera and chips
items.subtitle: Bold Salsalito turkey on Dave's Killer Bread with dill chips and Buona hot giardiniera, chips on the side. About 610 cal and 35 g protein.
items.prep: Layer about 4 oz of the turkey on two slices of bread with dill pickle chips and a spoonful of hot giardiniera. Bag a handful (1½ oz) of chips on the side.
items.photo: A deli sandwich on seeded whole-grain bread stacked with sliced spiced turkey breast, dill pickle chips and spicy Chicago giardiniera, with chips beside it.

swaps.why: There's no Orange Mango LYTE, but LYTE Orange Clementine is close — 20 calories instead of 110, and no added sugar (vs 23 g).
Same ranch-and-chicken salad with light ranch and no bacon or egg — roughly 200 fewer calories with about the same protein.
The bowl has only 14 g protein; 3 oz of grilled chicken adds about 24 g so it holds you until dinner.
Light ranch instead of a full ranch cup — about 125 fewer calories.
Baked chips keep the crunch with about 100 fewer calories and much less fat a bag.
Baked chips keep the crunch with less fat.
